name: Task checklist
what: A glass task list under your chin with a title line: its steps run one after another - a small loader spins on the running step, then it pops green with a tick and the next one starts; waiting steps are dimmed, the header ring fills and the counter counts; when the last one ticks the ring turns green too; it floats, a band of light crosses the glass, and it sinks away at the end.
origin: Rebuilt after the checklist and todo effects of claude-video-effects (MIT): a task list whose steps spin, then tick green one after another - MotionLab's own code, a glass card made part of the shot
motion: f0-f12 the card rises 140 px and grows from 96 % (slow end, seen within 4 f); from f10 one step at a time: its loader arc spins 18 degrees a frame for gap (20) frames, then the green disc pops (8 f, an overshoot) and its tick draws (6 f) while the next starts; the header ring fills a share per tick (8 f, slow end) and the counter counts; at the last tick + 4 f the header ring pops green with its own tick; it floats 3 px; a band of light crosses the glass 26 f (S-curve); the last 9 f it sinks 30 px and fades (accelerating)

tracks.name: card in
tracks.what: the glass list rises into place

tracks.name: step 1
tracks.what: the first step spins, then ticks green
tracks.easing: decelerating (slow end), an overshoot on the tick

tracks.name: step 2
tracks.what: the second step spins, then ticks green
tracks.easing: decelerating (slow end), an overshoot on the tick

tracks.name: step 3
tracks.what: the third step spins, then ticks green
tracks.easing: decelerating (slow end), an overshoot on the tick

tracks.name: step 4
tracks.what: the fourth step spins, then ticks green
tracks.easing: decelerating (slow end), an overshoot on the tick

tracks.name: all done
tracks.what: the header ring pops green with a tick

tracks.name: sheen
tracks.what: a band of light crosses the glass

tracks.name: card out
tracks.what: the list sinks away and fades

min_frames: start + round((10 + max(1, min(8, parts(steps))) * max(4, gap) + 14) * fps / 30)
min_why: the last step has to tick before it ends
